portfolio.methodologyChange: This is a full revision of the May 29, 2026 draft. Every PDF in public/documents/matter-XX/ (203 files) was measured with pdfinfo (poppler-utils) for real page counts, then classified by document type and priced by five parallel analysis passes (one per case cluster). The prior draft's page counts for several matters (e.g. Matter 3's purported 664-page complaint, Matter 5's purported 712-page complaint) were guesses that do not match any file actually in the repository and have been discarded in favor of ground truth.

billingPrinciples: Opposing counsel's filings (their MTDs, demurrers, replies) are billed only at a light review rate, never at full drafting rate — the hypothetical hire only drafts the plaintiff's own filings.
Near-duplicate/re-filed copies of the same document are billed once at full rate with only incremental hours for the duplicate.
Large PDFs that are discovery dumps, exhibit compilations, or scanned evidence bundles are billed at a lighter review/compilation rate, not full drafting rate, regardless of raw page count.
Writ of mandate and habeas corpus petitions are billed as flat specialized-practice blocks (40-80 hrs) rather than per-page, consistent with how such matters are actually billed in practice.
Matters with no uploaded PDFs (4, 11, 13, 17, 18) are estimated conservatively from matters.js status/procedural history text, not assumed to be zero-cost.
